name: FADE v0.2.0 - STOP/ALL Execution Modes
description: Implement and validate the new STOP/ALL execution mode system with bash loop orchestration for continuous story processing

userStories.title: Replace existing fade script with v0.2.0
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to install the new fade v0.2.0 script so that I can use the new STOP/ALL execution modes
acceptanceCriteria: Old fade script is backed up
New fade script is installed and executable
fade help shows v0.2.0 and documents STOP/ALL modes
fade init creates all expected files including prompt.md with new signal protocol

userStories.title: Validate fade status command
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to check my work queue without starting Claude so that I can see what's pending
acceptanceCriteria: fade status shows formatted work queue with colours
fade status --json outputs valid JSON
Priority PRD (prd.json) shown separately from queue (prds/)
Shows done/remaining counts per PRD
Empty queue shows helpful message

userStories.title: Validate STOP mode execution
userStories.description: As a developer, I want STOP mode to complete one story and halt so that I can review before continuing
acceptanceCriteria: fade run displays work queue
Prompt asks for STOP or ALL
Entering STOP or S starts Claude with context
Claude processes one story
Claude outputs STORY_DONE signal
Session ends - human must run fade run again

userStories.title: Validate ALL mode loop orchestration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want ALL mode to process multiple stories automatically with fresh context between each
acceptanceCriteria: Entering ALL or A starts the loop
Loop displays iteration number
Claude processes story and outputs STORY_DONE
Loop catches signal and restarts Claude with fresh context
Fresh context includes updated progress.md from previous iteration
Loop continues until ALL_COMPLETE or BLOCKED
Final message shows completion or blocked status

userStories.title: Validate signal detection robustness
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the loop to reliably detect exit signals so that it behaves predictably
acceptanceCriteria: STORY_DONE: US-XXX triggers loop continuation
ALL_COMPLETE triggers clean exit with success message
BLOCKED: [reason] triggers exit with intervention message
No signal triggers exit with warning message
Signals detected even with surrounding text

userStories.title: Update project documentation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the project docs updated so that they reflect v0.2.0 features
acceptanceCriteria: fade-project-description-updated.md reflects v0.2.0
fade-project-starter-updated.md reflects v0.2.0
STOP/ALL modes documented
chore: prefix documented (not toil:)
fade status command documented
Bash loop orchestration explained
